name: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
description: Produces the most influential cybersecurity standards and frameworks in the world, including NICE Framework, SP 800 Series, and Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.

peerReview.processDescription: NICE Framework: Public comment periods, revision cycles, community input through NICE Framework Users Group. SP 800 Series: Formal public review with Federal Register notices, expert panel reviews, comment periods. CSF 2.0: Extensive public comment, industry workshops, international peer review.

attribution.attributionNotes: NIST certifications and framework alignments are globally recognized. NICE Framework alignment used by employers, educators, and certification bodies worldwide.

povsAlignment.description: Gold standard for cybersecurity standards through formal public review with Federal Register notices.
